Airbnb's current CFO is **Elinor ("Ellie") Mertz**, based on filings dated on or before 16 May 2025.

- **Latest CFO certification:** Airbnb's Q1 2025 10-Q (filed 1 May 2025) includes Exhibit 31.2, the CFO's certification, and the name "Elinor Mertz" appears in it. The same exhibit matched a search for "Chief Financial Officer."
- **Same in the annual report:** The FY2024 10-K (filed 13 February 2025) has the same match in its Exhibit 31.2 and Exhibit 32.1 certifications.
- **Still filing in May:** Elinor Mertz kept filing Form 144 notices of planned share sales, most recently on 5 May 2025. So she was still an Airbnb insider as of the latest filings.

One limitation: I found this by matching search terms. I didn't open the exhibit text to read her signature and title, and the Form 4 data was too large to come back.

**Sources**
- Form 10-Q (Q1 2025), filed 2025-05-01, accession 0001559720-25-000017 (Exhibits 31.2 and 32.1)
- Form 10-K (FY2024), filed 2025-02-13, accession 0001559720-25-000010 (Exhibits 31.2 and 32.1)
- Form 144, filed 2025-05-05, accession 0001959173-25-002856
